name: openclaw
description: Run your own OpenClaw Gateway on ORB Cloud. Idle = $0, wake on inbound HTTP in <1s, persistent state across sleep. GLM (via Z.AI) is the only LLM provider in Phase 1; channels (Telegram/Discord/Slack) ship in Phase 2.

required_secrets.name: ZAI_API_KEY
required_secrets.obtain_at: https://z.ai/manage-apikey/apikey-list — sign up for the GLM Coding Plan
required_secrets.purpose: Z.AI API key. Sent to https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic via ORB's per-computer LLM proxy.

optional_inputs.name: DEPLOY_NAME
optional_inputs.purpose: Identifier for this deploy. Used in DELETE /v1/swarms/<id> for teardown.

exposes.purpose: OpenClaw Gateway — Control UI + RPC API for messages/sessions/agents.

phase_2_planned: channel pairing (Telegram bot token, Discord bot, Slack OAuth, WhatsApp QR)
web onboarding form on orbcloud.dev (vs curl-pipe-bash)
GitHub OAuth signup with free-tier monthly cap
